tools.name: request_sigvelo_demo
tools.description: Prepare a request for a free SigVelo demo using the visitor's work email. This does not schedule a calendar appointment. SigVelo will contact the visitor to arrange a time. Open the contact page with the email filled in, clearly explain what will happen, and ask the visitor to review and approve submission.

email.description: The visitor's work email address, which SigVelo will use to contact them and arrange a free demo.
